data.text: Implemented PhasedJob/PhasedJobHandler as a native JobHandler adapter: private work/finalization scopes borrow the same execution services; a required classifier accepts retained complete failure evidence and returns only JobFailure. Core lower-level scoped driver reuses command polling/destruction without a new execution engine; it is explicitly host-owned, not a cancellable application bracket. The protected adapter exposes no separate runner/waiter; native invocation death still interrupts finalization. Four focused integration tests passed including early errors, panic, work timeout, both-phase failures, borrowed checkpoint persistence, native finalizer deadline and invocation destruction. Core/adapter doctests and focused Clippy passed. Migrated the real single-dependency consumer to protected registration; source-copy/native verification underway. No public hard cuts; serde_json changes from optional test-only declaration to normal dependency already present transitively.

The Git-free single-facade consumer passed: 14 consumer tests, 3 harness tests and a Docker-backed run with two durable jobs plus PostgreSQL quota. Both jobs use PhasedJob and persist their finalization checkpoint. Updated the canonical facade example and integration/consumer guides to lead with PhasedJob; the manual APIs remain explicitly lower-level. Full verify is running; an initial file-budget subprocess-cleanup failure was reproduced and then passed on retry with no budget-policy changes.

User explicitly rejected compatibility paths and requested a hard cutover for every consumer. Removing Bulkhead::enter entirely, migrating fixtures to parked execution rather than raw permits, and migrating all application callers. Durable transaction consumers require the existing retained-outcome resolver semantics to be available inside owned admission. The prior full verification was stopped at the workspace matrix because this scope change invalidates it.

User requested a hard cutover, rejecting source-compatible lower-level paths. Removing public job_phases and migrating native handler consumers to PhasedJob, including the reference provider protocol and test harnesses. Existing published raw-phase composition will have no deprecated shim because it restores the skipped-finalization ordering. PR 106 remains draft during cutover.
